content: Bieŋ nuɔsiba ndii yuntesĩnni‑i
Ku huoŋgu-na, miɛ mi ne da *dɔrpɔpuɔrbiloŋo naŋo hiire u jo. Fobabalaaŋgu diele waa u naŋga-na baa jɔlgɔbuɔ naŋo.
Uŋ juɔ ji hi, u bel jĩɛbĩncɔiŋo‑i. U yerre yaa *Sitãni, dinande yaa *Bigãarãŋo. U bilaa-yo vaa-yo baa jɔlgɔ‑i u duɔ ce bieŋ nuɔsiba ndii.

Uŋ vaa-yo dumaaŋo-na, u sɛ-yo dii-yo fobabalaaŋgu-na aa gbonu-kuɔ baa diele‑i aa tiɛlaa-kuɔ wuɔ u baa gbãa hel ka pira moloŋo bieŋ daaya hɔlma-na. Bieŋ daaya da a cor, ba ka suɔ hiel-o nanna u da yinni cɛllɛ.

Kufaŋgu huoŋgu-na, mi da fɔ̃ŋgɔ̃taaŋ-titiɛŋa. Bamaŋ waa tĩɛna-yɛi ba hãa-ba fɔ̃ŋgũɔ‑i ba ta ba gɛr. Aa baŋ kuɔ bamaŋ wuɔ ba cuu Yesu ninsoŋo huoŋ-nu, baŋ kuɔ bamaŋ Diiloŋ-nelma maama-na, miɛ bi da bafamba yalɛiŋa‑i. Kufaŋgu taamba saa ta ba dũuna bĩŋwobalŋo yaaŋga-na baa u karkuuyo
bi yaaŋga-na. Ba saa naa bi haa u dãnyuɔ‑i ba fɛrɛŋ nuɔ. Kuŋ ciɛ dumaaŋo-na, baa sire kuoŋ-nelle-na a jo ji tĩɛna fɔ̃ŋgũɔ‑i-na baa *Kirsa‑i da ba ce bieŋ nuɔsiba ndii.
Kuomba siredĩɛlãmma yaa‑i mafamma‑i. Banamba ka cie bieŋ daaya ka tĩ aa ba suɔ sire.

Bamaŋ ka sire siredĩɛlãmma-na, ba yunni dɔlaa! Baŋ yeŋ Diiloŋ-baamba, hãalĩŋ-kuliiŋgu yufelle bɛi. Ba ka ce *Diilojigãntaamba baa *Kirsa jigãntaamba aa ba ka tĩɛna fɔ̃ŋgũɔ‑i-na baa Kirsa‑i bieŋ nuɔsiba ndii daayo-na.
Ba yaraa Sitãni‑i
Bieŋ nuɔsiba ndii-waaŋ daaya da a cor, ba ka hiel *Sitãni‑i u kaso‑i-na.
Duɔ hel, u ka wuɔra bĩŋ nilɛiŋa-na hiere a tãal Gɔgi‑i baa Magɔgi‑i
. Ba bĩ nelbiliemba yaa dumaaŋo-na. U ka wuɔra gbura-bɛi wuɔ ba ji ce bɛrru baa Diiloŋo‑i. Ba ka hel ŋaa nyɛiŋo.
Ba hilaa terni-na hiere a jo ji dii Diiloŋ-baamba terieŋgu‑i huɔŋga, Diiloŋ uŋ kuyeŋ nelle maŋ maama‑i, ba juɔ ji dii-de huɔŋga. Ŋga dãamu hilaa dɔrɔ‑i-na a jo ji kukul-ba hiere.
Sitãni maŋ taa u tãal-ba, ba bilaa ufaŋo‑i dii-yo dãŋgbɔguɔŋgu-na u kã ka yuɔ bĩŋwobalŋo‑i baa u pɔpuɔrbiloŋo‑i
. Ba ka ce sũlma‑i terieŋgu-na bãaŋgu‑i baa isuɔŋgu‑i ba sa ji hel-mɛi dede.
Diiloŋ uŋ ka gɛr dumaa
Ku huoŋgu-na, mi da fɔ̃ŋgɔ̃taaŋ-tetembuɔ naŋo‑i, u waa uupilaŋo; baa u Tieŋo‑i u dɔrɔ. Dɔrɔ‑i baa hĩɛma‑i ni gbar halaŋ kutieŋo caaŋgu-na, molo saa ji tiraa da-ni.

Ku huoŋgu-na, mi da nelbɔ̃mbɔ̃mbaa-ba maŋ kuu baa nyuɔnyuɔ-baamba‑i hiere, ba yiɛraaya fɔ̃ŋgɔ̃taaŋ-teterre yaaŋga-na, aa da sɛbɛbaa-ba namba puurii, aa bi da cicɛ̃lmaŋ-wuoŋo puurii. Baa gɛr kuoŋ daaba‑i hiere ba ãndaaŋgu‑i a saanu baa baŋ ciɛ kumaŋ hĩɛma-na, a saanu baa mamaŋ nyɛgãaŋ sɛbɛbaa daaba-na.
Hũmmaŋ wuyaa nuɔmba maŋ hiere, maa jo baa-ba. Kuliiŋgu‑i baa kuoŋ-nelleŋ wuyaa bamaŋ hiere, niɛ jo baa-ba. Baa gɛr ba ãndaaŋgu‑i hiere a saanu baa ba maacemma‑i.
Baŋ juɔ gɛr-ba tĩ, baa sɛ kuliiŋgu‑i baa kuoŋ-nelle‑i dii-ni dãŋgbɔguɔŋgu-na. Hãalĩŋ-kuliiŋgu yaa dãŋgbɔguɔŋ daaku‑i.
Bamaŋ yirɛiŋa‑i saa waa cicɛ̃lmaŋ-sɛbɛ‑i-na hiere baa bi sɛ bafamba‑i dii-ba dãŋgbɔguɔŋgu-na.

footnotes.text: Gɔgi‑i baa Magɔgi‑i: Ba bĩ Diiloŋ-bigãarãamba yaa dumaaŋo-na bande‑i-na. Niɛŋ Esekiɛl sɛbɛ‑i-na (Ézéchiel) 38.2; 39.1.
Bĩŋwobalŋo‑i baa u pɔpuɔrbiloŋo‑i, ne-ku 19.20 baa naaruɔ‑i cicaara‑i-na.
